title: PipelineRunnerContract
description: CLI parameters and execution contract for unified data & AI pipeline runner. The schema represents the parsed canonical request; the CLI accepts the equivalent comma-separated steps string.

all_products.description: Explicitly select the full product catalog

steps.description: Canonical parsed steps in fixed DAG order crawl,sentence_split,sentiment,report,index. CLI serialization accepts the same names in any order or standalone all; duplicates are rejected before schema validation.

interval_hours.description: Periodic foreground run interval in hours (0 for a single run; process lifetime is managed by Docker or an external supervisor)

resume_run_id.description: Exact FAILED run_id to resume. Its original selector and canonical steps must match this request; the runner must never auto-select among failed runs.
